_comment: The language models YuE2 Write Song and YuE2 Transcribe offer for download.
This is the pack's copy. The live one is ComfyUI/user/yue2_comfy/writers.json:
it is made from this on first use, and edits there survive an update of the pack.
Each entry: name (what the list shows), repo (a Hugging Face repository),
file (the .gguf inside it, or a full path to a file on this machine with no repo),
download_gb (in 1024**3 bytes, as the progress bar counts them), vram (a short
note on the card it needs) and note.
A GGUF put into ComfyUI/models/LLM is offered without being listed here.

writers.name: Qwen3.5-4B Q4_K_M
writers.note: The pack's default: small, fast, good enough for most songs.

writers.name: Qwen3.5-9B Q4_K_M
writers.note: A step up from the default on an 8-12 GB card.

writers.name: Gemma 4 12B Q4_K_M
writers.note: Google's mid-size model; another voice for the lyrics.

writers.name: Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M
writers.note: A large model for a 24 GB card.

writers.name: Gemma 4 26B-A4B Q4_K_M
writers.note: Mixture of experts: large, but answers about as fast as a 4B.

writers.name: Gemma 4 31B Q4_K_M
writers.note: Google's largest dense model; slower than the 26B-A4B.

writers.name: Qwen3.6-27B Q5_K_M
writers.note: A large model for a 24 GB card.

writers.name: Gemma 4 26B-A4B Q6_K
writers.note: The 26B-A4B at a finer quantisation, for a 32 GB card.
